message.content: {"note_claim":"When goods and services are included, the U.S. trade deficit with Canada can be far below $60 billion annually.","label":"PARTIAL","quote":"The 2025 deficit was $27.35 billion, a decrease from 2024's deficit of $39.4 billion.","reason":"The page supports that recent goods-and-services deficits were below $60 billion, but it does not establish the stated ten-year average or years of U.S. surplus."}

parsed.note_claim: When goods and services are included, the U.S. trade deficit with Canada can be far below $60 billion annually.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: The 2025 deficit was $27.35 billion, a decrease from 2024's deficit of $39.4 billion.
parsed.reason: The page supports that recent goods-and-services deficits were below $60 billion, but it does not establish the stated ten-year average or years of U.S. surplus.
